subject: science
title: Animals, Including Humans
description: Why humans and some animals need nutrition from what they eat, the different food groups, and how skeletons and muscles support, protect and move the body.

objectives.statement: Identify that animals, including humans, need the right types and amount of nutrition, and that they cannot make their own food; they get nutrition from what they eat.
Identify that humans and some other animals have skeletons and muscles for support, protection and movement.
